dedupe_keys.name: monitoring data from two large scale solar process heat plants izmir parabolic trough and condat flat plate

description: These two companion Zenodo releases give operational monitoring data from commercial solar plants that supply industrial process heat. The Condat record covers a Newheat plant at Condat-sur-Vézère, France: 264 tracked flat-plate collectors (4,212 m2) with a 500 m3 hot water store that preheat boiler make-up water for paper production, displacing natural gas, for the whole of 2020 at 1-minute resolution (CSV of about 85 MB) with a SunPeek ISO 24194 Power Check report. The Izmir record covers a Soliterm plant in Turkey: 3,087 m2 of tracked parabolic trough collectors using water, with a solar-driven absorption chiller, hourly from September 2021 to September 2022 without November to March (CSV of about 0.3 MB) with plant diagrams. Both were published on 27 February 2026 by the operators with AEE INTEC co-authors, with collector parameters in JSON, free under CC BY-SA 4.0. Coverage is two plants. Caveats: the Izmir data leave out winter months and are hourly, and the industrial processes served are described only briefly. For simulation they give measured solar heat output to model how much fossil boiler fuel industrial solar can replace and its variability. Related catalogue records include IndustryHeat-EU and the Hotmaps industrial sites.
